<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include">
    <sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <access>package_private</access>
        <active>true</active>
        <api_name>global.MIDProfileManagement</api_name>
        <caller_access/>
        <client_callable>false</client_callable>
        <description/>
        <mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable>
        <name>MIDProfileManagement</name>
        <sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable>
        <script><![CDATA[var MIDProfileManagement = Class.create();

MIDProfileManagement.prototype = {

	initialize: function() {
		this.profile_table_name = "mid_server_profile";

		this.sys_id_field_name = "sys_id";

		this.missing_on_mid_msg = "Missing on MID.";
		this.difference_from_profile_msg = "Difference.";
		this.not_defined_in_profile_msg = "Not Defined In Profile.";
		this.m2mTables = {
			"Cluster": {profileM2M: "mid_profile_cluster_m2m", agentM2M: "ecc_agent_cluster_member_m2m", profileFilterField: "profile", agentFilterField: "agent", gather_field_name: "cluster", target_table: "ecc_agent_cluster"},
			"Application": {profileM2M: "mid_profile_application_m2m", agentM2M: "ecc_agent_application_m2m", profileFilterField: "profile", agentFilterField: "agent", gather_field_name: "application", target_table: "ecc_agent_application"},
			"IP Range": {profileM2M: "mid_profile_ip_range_m2m", agentM2M: "ecc_agent_ip_range_m2m", profileFilterField: "profile", agentFilterField: "agent", gather_field_name: "ip_range", target_table: "ecc_agent_ip_range"},
			"Capability" : {profileM2M: "mid_profile_capability_m2m", agentM2M: "ecc_agent_capability_m2m", profileFilterField: "profile", agentFilterField: "agent", gather_field_name: "capability", target_table: "ecc_agent_capability"}
		};
	},

	/**
	 * verifies the profile specified config matches with the list of MID's provided.
	 *
	 * @param profile_number 	a string variable represnting the profile number to be validated against.
	 * @param mid_sys_ids 		a list containing the sys ids of all the mids to be validated. If the list is null, undefined or
	 *       					empty, all the mids associated with profile number will be validated.
	 * @param trigger_profile_validation_requests 	a boolean value to indicate if the profile validation ecc requests need to be triggered
	 *
	 * @returns an JSON string containing all the data found as part of validation.
	 */
    verifyProfile: function(profile_number, mid_sys_ids, trigger_profile_validation_requests) {

		var result_obj = {};

		result_obj.mids = [];
		result_obj.profile = profile_number;
		result_obj.mid_mismatch_data = [];
		result_obj.errors = [];
		result_obj.mismatch_count = 0;

		var mid_list = mid_sys_ids;

		// scan all mids associated with the profile if no mid has been specified
		if (!mid_list?.length)
			mid_list = this.getMIDSysIDList(profile_number);

		this.generateVerificationResults(mid_list, profile_number, result_obj);

		if (trigger_profile_validation_requests) {
			result_obj.wrapper_request_data = new MIDWrapperConfigOperations().createVerifyWrapperECCRequests(mid_list, false);
		}
		return result_obj;
	},

	/**
	 * returns list of all sys_ids associated with a profile
	 *
	 * @param profile_number a string value denoting a profile number
	 *
	 * @returns a list of sys_ids of mid servers
	 */
	getMIDSysIDList: function(profile_number) {

		var profile_gr = this.getGlideRecord(this.profile_table_name, "number", profile_number);

		if (profile_gr == null) {
			return new Array();
		}

		var profile_sys_id = profile_gr.getValue(this.sys_id_field_name);
		return this.filterRecordsGetColumnValue("ecc_agent", "profile_id", profile_sys_id, this.sys_id_field_name);
	},

	/**
	 * Performs verification and fills the result in result_obj
	 *
	 * @param mid_sys_id_list 	list of mid sys ids to be verified
	 * @param profile_number 	string value of profile number to be verified
	 * @param result_object 	object into which the data needs to be filled
	 */
	generateVerificationResults: function(mid_sys_id_list, profile_number, result_obj) {

		var profile_gr = this.getGlideRecord(this.profile_table_name, "number", profile_number);

		if (profile_gr == null) {
			result_obj.errors.push("Invalid profile number: " + profile_number);
			return;
		}

		if (mid_sys_id_list.length == 0) {
			result_obj.errors.push("No MID Server found for validation of profile: " + profile_number);
			return;
		}

		var profile_sys_id = profile_gr.getValue(this.sys_id_field_name);

		mid_sys_id_list.forEach(mid_sys_id => {

			result_obj.mids.push(mid_sys_id);

			var mid_gr = this.getGlideRecord("ecc_agent", this.sys_id_field_name, mid_sys_id);

			var mid_result_data = {};
			mid_result_data.sys_id = mid_sys_id;
			mid_result_data.status = "";
			mid_result_data.mismatch_count = 0;
			mid_result_data.name = "";
			mid_result_data.errors = [];
			mid_result_data.mismatches = [];

			if(mid_gr == null){
				mid_result_data.errors.push("MID record not found. Might have been deleted. Mid ID:" + mid_sys_id);
				mid_result_data.name = "";
				mid_result_data.status = "Invalid";
				result_obj.mid_mismatch_data.push(mid_result_data);
				return;
			}

			mid_result_data.name = mid_gr.getValue("name");
			mid_result_data.status = mid_gr.getValue("status");

			this.performComponentVerification(mid_sys_id, profile_sys_id, mid_result_data);

			result_obj.mid_mismatch_data.push(mid_result_data);
			result_obj.mismatch_count += parseInt(mid_result_data.mismatch_count);
		});
	},

	/**
	 * function to perform profile validation on a single mid
	 *
	 * @param mid_sys_id 		the sys id of mid
	 * @param profile_sys_id 	the sys id of profile
	 * @param mid_result_data 	the data structure in which the result will be added
	 */
	performComponentVerification: function(mid_sys_id, profile_sys_id, mid_result_data) {
		for (var type in this.m2mTables)
			this.performDataMatch(type, mid_sys_id, profile_sys_id, mid_result_data);
		this.matchMidProfileConfigs(mid_sys_id, profile_sys_id, mid_result_data);
		this.matchMidProperties(mid_sys_id, profile_sys_id, mid_result_data);
	},

	/**
	 * Perfroms the match of mid configuration against the profile configurations
	 *
	 * @param type				type of match
	 * @param mid_sys_id		Sys ID of the mid
	 * @param profile_sys_id	Sys ID of the profile
	 * @param mid_result_data	The object in which the result needs to be added
	 */
	performDataMatch: function(type, mid_sys_id, profile_sys_id, mid_result_data) {
		var matchMap = this.m2mTables[type];
		const in_profile = this.filterRecordsGetColumnValue(matchMap.profileM2M, matchMap.profileFilterField, profile_sys_id, matchMap.gather_field_name);
		const in_mid = this.filterRecordsGetColumnValue(matchMap.agentM2M, matchMap.agentFilterField, mid_sys_id, matchMap.gather_field_name);

		const [profile_unique, common_clusters, mid_unique] = this.compareArrayValues(in_profile, in_mid);

		const cluster_table = matchMap.target_table;
		var data = this.createComponentIssue(type);

		profile_unique.forEach (id => {
			var gr = this.getGlideRecord(cluster_table, this.sys_id_field_name, id);

			if(gr != null)
				data.data.push(this.createMismatchRecordByType(type, id, gr, this.missing_on_mid_msg));
		});

		mid_unique.forEach (id => {
			var gr = this.getGlideRecord(cluster_table, this.sys_id_field_name, id);

			if(gr != null)
				data.data.push(this.createMismatchRecordByType(type, id, gr, this.not_defined_in_profile_msg));
		});

		if (data.data.length > 0) {
			data.mismatch_count = parseInt(data.data.length);
			mid_result_data.mismatches.push(data);
			mid_result_data.mismatch_count += parseInt(data.mismatch_count);
		}
	},

	/**
	 * verifies the mid properties against profile capability properties
	 *
	 * @params	mid_sys_id		sys of mid
	 * @params	profile_sys_id 	sys id of profile
	 * @param	mid_result_data	the data structure in which the result will be added
	 */
	matchMidProperties: function (mid_sys_id, profile_sys_id, mid_result_data) {

		const profile_property_map = this.fetchDataMap("mid_profile_property", "profile", profile_sys_id, "name", "value");
		const mid_property_map = this.fetchDataMap("ecc_agent_property", "ecc_agent", mid_sys_id, "name", "value");
		this.processMapMatch(profile_property_map, mid_property_map, "Property", mid_result_data);
	},

	/**
	 * verifies the mid configurations-params against profile configurations-params properties
	 *
	 * @params	mid_sys_id		sys of mid
	 * @params	profile_sys_id 	sys id of profile
	 * @param	mid_result_data	the data structure in which the result will be added
	 */
	matchMidProfileConfigs: function(mid_sys_id, profile_sys_id, mid_result_data) {

		const map_on_profile_specific_keys = this.sanitizeConfigs(this.fetchDataMap("mid_profile_config", "profile", profile_sys_id, "name", "value"));
		const map_on_mid_specific_keys = this.sanitizeConfigs(this.fetchDataMap("ecc_agent_config", "ecc_agent", mid_sys_id, "param_name", "value"));
		this.processMapMatch(map_on_profile_specific_keys, map_on_mid_specific_keys, "Config", mid_result_data);
	},

	/**
	 * creates and returns an filled mismatch object
	 *
	 * @param type			Type of mismatch object
	 * @param sys_id		Sys Id of mismatch object
	 * @param glide_record	The record using which the mismatch needs to be created
	 * @param description	Descrition text for the mismatch record.
	 *
	 * @returns a object containing values for the mismatch
	 */
	createMismatchRecordByType: function(type, sys_id, glide_record, description) {
		switch(type) {
			case "Cluster":
				return this.createClusterIssue(sys_id, glide_record, description);
			case "Application":
				return this.createApplicationIssue(sys_id, glide_record, description);
			case "IP Range":
				return this.createIPRangeIssue(sys_id, glide_record, description);
			case "Capability":
				return this.createCapabilityIssue(sys_id, glide_record, description);
		}
	},

	/**
	 * Creates the structure to store all mismatches related to a mid configuration comonent
	 *
	 * @param	component_type	string value denoting the type of mid configuration
	 *
	 * @returns an object to sore the mismatches related to the component
	 */
	createComponentIssue: function(component_type) {
		var data = {};
		data.type = component_type;
		data.data = [];
		data.mismatch_count = 0;
		return data;
	},

	/**
	 * creates the object to store the cluste analysis results
	 *
	 * @param	cluster_sys_id			Sys ID of cluster
	 * @param 	glide_record			The record using which the issue needs to be created
	 * @param	mismatch_description  	An string detail of nature of mismatch
	 *
	 * @returns an object of Cluster Issue
	 */
	createClusterIssue: function(cluster_sys_id, glide_record, mismatch_description){

		var clusterIssue = {};
		clusterIssue.cluster_sys_id = cluster_sys_id;
		clusterIssue.name = glide_record.getValue("name");
		clusterIssue.type = glide_record.getValue("type");
		clusterIssue.description = mismatch_description;
		return clusterIssue;
	},

	/**
	 * creates the object to store the application analysis results
	 *
	 * @param	application_sys_id		Sys ID of application
	 * @param	glide_record			The record using which the issue needs to be created
	 * @param	mismatch_description  	An string detail of nature of mismatch
	 *
	 * @returns an object of Application Issue
	 */
	createApplicationIssue(application_sys_id, glide_record, mismatch_description) {
		var application_mismatch = {};
		application_mismatch.application_sys_id = application_sys_id;
		application_mismatch.name = glide_record.getValue("name");
		application_mismatch.description = mismatch_description;
		return application_mismatch;
	},

	/**
	 * creates the object to store the IP Range analysis results
	 *
	 * @param	ip_range_sys_id			Sys ID of IP Range
	 * @param	glide_record			The record using which the issue needs to be created
	 * @param	mismatch_description  	An string detail of nature of mismatch
	 *
	 * @returns an object of IP Range Issue
	 */
	createIPRangeIssue: function(ip_range_sys_id, glide_record, mismatch_description) {
		var ip_range_mismatch = {};
		ip_range_mismatch.ip_range_sys_id = ip_range_sys_id;
		ip_range_mismatch.name = glide_record.getValue("name");
		ip_range_mismatch.range = glide_record.getValue("range");
		ip_range_mismatch.description = mismatch_description;
		return ip_range_mismatch;
	},

	/**
	 * creates the object to store the Capability analysis results
	 *
	 * @param	capability_sys_id		Sys ID of Capability
	 * @param	glide_record			The record using which the issue needs to be created
	 * @param	mismatch_description  	An string detail of nature of mismatch
	 *
	 * @returns an object of IP Range Issue
	 */
	createCapabilityIssue: function(capability_sys_id, glide_record, mismatch_description) {
		var capability_mismatch = {};
		capability_mismatch.capability_sys_id = capability_sys_id;
		capability_mismatch.name = glide_record.getValue("capability");
		capability_mismatch.value = glide_record.getValue("capability_value");
		capability_mismatch.description = mismatch_description;
		return capability_mismatch;
	},

	/**
	 * Compares arrays and returns the unique and common value list
	 *
	 * @param comparision_array_1	a list
	 * @param comparision_array_2	a list
	 *
	 * @returns an array with three values, where
	 * 		first element:  contains list of all unique values in array1
	 * 		second element: contains list of common values in array1 and array2
	 * 		third element:	contains list of all unique values in array2
	 */
	compareArrayValues: function (comparision_array_1, comparision_array_2) {

		const unique_in_array_1 = comparision_array_1.filter(x => !comparision_array_2.includes(x)).sort();
		const unique_in_array_2 = comparision_array_2.filter(x => !comparision_array_1.includes(x)).sort();
		const common = comparision_array_1.filter(x => comparision_array_2.includes(x)).sort();

		return [unique_in_array_1, common, unique_in_array_2];
	},

	/**
	 * Create a key based mismatch object based on parameter
	 *
	 * @param key					The key that has mismatch
	 * @param profile_value			The value of key on profile
	 * @param mid_value				The value of key on mid server
	 * @param mismatch_description		An string detail of nature of mismatch
	 *
	 * @returns	The mismatch object
	 */
	createIssue: function(key, profile_value, mid_value, mismatch_description) {
		var mismatch = {};
		mismatch.key = key;
		mismatch.profile_value = profile_value;
		mismatch.mid_value = mid_value;
		mismatch.description = mismatch_description;
		return mismatch;
	},

	/**
	 * process match for maps of properties obtained from profile and mid
	 *
	 * @param map_profile_keys		a map of key values as obtained from profile
	 * @param map_mid_keys			a map of key values as obtained from MID
	 * @param type					the type of config/properties being considered
	 * @param mid_result_data		the data structure in which the result will be added
	 */
	processMapMatch: function(map_profile_keys, map_mid_keys, type, mid_result_data) {
		const [profile_unique_config, common_config, mid_unique_config] = this.segregateKeys(map_profile_keys, map_mid_keys);

		var data = this.createComponentIssue(type);

		common_config.forEach(key => {
			if(map_profile_keys.get(key) != map_mid_keys.get(key))
				data.data.push(this.createIssue(key, map_profile_keys.get(key), map_mid_keys.get(key), this.difference_from_profile_msg));
		});

		profile_unique_config.forEach(key => {
			data.data.push(this.createIssue(key, map_profile_keys.get(key), "-", this.missing_on_mid_msg));
		});

		// remove parameter that mid adds to config with default values
		this.getMIDConfigDefaults().forEach((value,key) => {

			const index = mid_unique_config.indexOf(key);
			if (index > -1 && value == map_mid_keys.get(key))
				mid_unique_config.splice(index, 1);
		});

		mid_unique_config.forEach(key => {
			data.data.push(this.createIssue(key, "-", map_mid_keys.get(key), this.not_defined_in_profile_msg));
		});

		if (data.data.length > 0) {
			data.mismatch_count = parseInt(data.data.length);
			mid_result_data.mismatch_count += parseInt(data.mismatch_count);
			mid_result_data.mismatches.push(data);
		}
	},


	/**
	 * Compares keys in the maps and returns the unique and common value list
	 * 
	 * @param comparision_map_1		a map
	 * @param comparision_map_2		a map
	 * 
	 * @returns an array with three values, where
	 * 		first element:  contains list of all unique keys to map 1
	 * 		second element: contains list of common keys in map 1 and map 2
	 * 		third element:	contains list of all unique keys in array2
	 */
	segregateKeys: function(comparision_map_1, comparision_map_2) {
		const map_1_keys = Array.from(comparision_map_1.keys());
		const map_2_keys = Array.from(comparision_map_2.keys());

		const map1_unique_keys = map_1_keys.filter(x => !map_2_keys.includes(x)).sort();
		const map2_unique_keys = map_2_keys.filter(x => !map_1_keys.includes(x)).sort();

		const common_keys = map_1_keys.filter(x => map_2_keys.includes(x)).sort();
		
		return [map1_unique_keys, common_keys, map2_unique_keys];
	},

	/**
	 * Function to clean up config map and remove entries that should be ignored
	 * 
	 * @param config_map	the map to be snatized
	 * 
	 * @returns updated config map
	 */
	sanitizeConfigs(config_map) {
		var IGNORED_PARAMS = ["mid.buildstamp", "mid_sys_id", "keypairs.mid_id", "home_dir", "mid_profile_id","name"];
		IGNORED_PARAMS.forEach(key => {config_map.delete(key);});

		var keys = new Array();
		config_map.forEach((value, key) => { keys.push(key); });

		keys.forEach(key => {
			var mcp = SncMIDConfigParameter.byName(key);
			if (mcp.isHidden() || !mcp.isListed())
				config_map.delete(key);
			
		});

		return config_map;
	},

	/**
	 * function to return the list of properties that are created by mid as default and need to be ignored
	 */
	getMIDConfigDefaults: function(){
		var ret = new Map();
		ret.set("mid.ssl.use.instance.security.policy", "false");
		ret.set("mid.cloud.provider", "none");
		return ret;
	},

	/**
	 * filters all key value pairs against a filter on table
	 * 
	 * @param table_name		table from which the vales needs to be searched
	 * @param filter_field		column of table that is to be used as filter
	 * @param filter_val		query filter that is to be applied to column
	 * @param name_field		field in table entry that stores key
	 * @param value_field		field in table entry that stores values
	 * 
	 * @returns a map with all filtered key values
	 */
	fetchDataMap: function(table_name, filter_field, filter_val, name_field, value_field) {
		var result = new Map();

		var gr = new GlideRecord(table_name);
		gr.addQuery(filter_field, filter_val);
		gr.query();

		while(gr.next()) {
			result.set(gr.getValue(name_field), gr.getValue(value_field));
		}

		return result;
	},

	/**
	 * Gathers all the column values after filtering records as per specified filter value
	 * 
	 * @param	table_name			name of the target table
	 * @param	filter_field		name of column to used to filter
	 * @param	filter_val			value of filter to be used in query
	 * @param	gather_field_name	name of field whose values will be gathered
	 * 
	 * @returns a list of values
	 */
	filterRecordsGetColumnValue: function(table_name, filter_field, filter_val, gather_field_name) {
		var return_array = new Array();
		
		var gr = new GlideRecord(table_name);
		gr.addQuery(filter_field, filter_val);
		gr.query();
		
		while(gr.next())
			return_array.push(gr.getValue(gather_field_name));
		
		return return_array;
	},

	/**
	 * returns the first record that matches the filter on table
	 * 
	 * @param	table_name		name of table
	 * @param	filter_field	name of field to filter on
	 * @param	filter_value	value of filter field
	 */
	getGlideRecord: function(table_name, filter_field, filter_value) {
		if(!filter_value || !filter_field || !table_name)
			return null;
		
		var profile_gr = new GlideRecord(table_name);
		profile_gr.addQuery(filter_field, filter_value);
		profile_gr.query();
		
		if (!profile_gr.next())
			return null;

		return profile_gr;
	},

    type: 'MIDProfileManagement'
};]]></script>
